INSTINCT MI350 SERIES RAMP. Lisa Su: 'We delivered record Instinct GPU revenue in the fourth quarter led by the ramp of MI350 Series shipments.' 'Today, eight of the top 10 AI companies use Instinct to power production workloads across a growing range of use cases.' In Q&A: 'MI355 has done well, and we were pleased with the performance in Q4. And we continue to ramp that in the first half of the year.' Even after backing out China, 'you would still see growth you'll see growth from Q3 to Q4' in data center AI. Software: 'Millions of large language and multimodal models run out of the box on AMD', with new upstream integration of AMD GPUs in VLLM.

quarterly_data.signal: Record ATM (OSAT) revenue NTD 126.1B (+12% QoQ, +36% YoY) with ATM gross margin 27.3% and operating margin 15.7%; full-year 2026 ATM revenue expected to grow ~35%. Capacity is the binding constraint — blended utilization 80-85% but 'generally very close to being full', with near-term growth gated by equipment installation and building construction. Q4 2026 ATM gross margin is likely to EXCEED the 30% structural ceiling, after which management will review raising the 26-29% structural margin range upward; pricing environment described as friendly, with material and component cost inflation passed through to customers.
